issues.failure_explanation: Both thm:nearest-image-corrected-conv (eq:nearest-image-total-field-error) and thm:computable-convergence (eq:field-convergence) state the field error bound for every compact K contained in Omega_R. In the PML-layer part of Omega_R the reconstructed fields approximate the exponentially damped PML (complex-scaled) solution, while u is the undamped outgoing physical field, so the stated H^1(K) bounds cannot hold for K in the layer; this is exactly why eq:pde-conv and thm:exact-conv restrict the same estimate to K contained in Omega_p. The proofs combine density/kernel estimates (valid on Omega_R) with thm:exact-conv/eq:pde-conv, which are available only for K in Omega_p, and u_sigma^ni is even defined only on Omega_p; hence the arguments prove strictly less than the statements claim, and the claimed layer-regime convergence is false.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: The unit normal $\nu$ points to the exterior of $\mathbb R^2_{\Sigma,+}$, i.e. downward on the flat part of the boundary.

issues.failure_explanation: Globally, nu points downward on flat parts of Gamma_R, so the one-sided conormal is nu.A_sigma.grad = -alpha_1 d/dn with n the upward coordinate (the lower half-line problem is posed in n<0, fixing the orientation). The flat model instead defines the one-sided conormals as +alpha_1 d/dn and asserts this is the same convention as in the jump formula; with it, however, the single-layer conormal jump is -q, the opposite of the +M_beta phi jump in eq:identity-conormal-jump. Hence the flat Robin problems (eq:lower-flat-model, eq:upper-flat-model) are the sign-flipped versions of the one-sided problems (eq:Tminus-problem, eq:Rplus-problem) defining Q_sigma: on a flat line the symbol of the true Q_sigma = I - (A^0)^{-1} is (-tau-Z)/(tau-Z) (from the S-symbol 1/(2 tau), K=0, M_beta=-Z), the reciprocal of the symbol (tau-Z)/(-tau-Z) derived in eq:Qflat-symbol. The coupling verification eq:QBim-coupling-check in the proof of lem:QBim-correction-separated subtracts the flat pair's Robin condition from the exact pair's as if the conventions agreed; with the flipped convention this leaves a nonzero residual (of size 2Z(f_sigma - gamma_+ U^+_{sigma,t}) on supp chi_im), so the proof is invalid and Q_{sigma,t} as defined does not approximate Q_sigma.

failure_location.quote: On $n=0$ we use the same conormal convention as in the jump formula, namely \(\partial_{\nu_\sigma,-}w:=\alpha_1\partial_nw(s,0^-)\) and \(\partial_{\nu_\sigma,+}w:=\alpha_1\partial_nw(s,0^+)\).

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Flip the flat-model conormal definitions to -alpha_1 d/dn (agreeing with the global convention and the Jiang-Li Green function); eq:Qflat-symbol becomes its reciprocal, still controlled by the bound eq:flat-ratio, the coupling check then closes, and the signs of the Robin datum and the upper Green function in lem:QBim-separated-fields are adjusted accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: The local model Q_{sigma,t}, the symbol formula eq:Qflat-symbol, and the proof of lem:QBim-correction-separated are unreliable as written; the proofs of lem:QBim-family, cor:Ainv-Bim-small, and thm:computable-convergence, which route through this lemma, are not valid as written.
issues.title: Flat half-line model uses a sign-flipped conormal convention, so Q_{sigma,t} models the wrong Robin problems and the local-correction proof fails
issues.why_classification: A forced local sign correction: the already-proven bound eq:flat-ratio controls the corrected symbol, no lemma or theorem statement changes, and only mechanical re-computation of the same steps is needed.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof of lem:QBim-correction-separated computes the source terms for W = U_sigma - eta U_{sigma,t} via eq:QBim-commutator, which uses L_sigma U^pm_{sigma,t} = 0 and the coefficient alpha_1^{-1}. This is valid only where the true and flat coefficients agree, i.e. |n| < L_2 (alpha_2 = 1). The strips C_b^pm = Omega_R^pm intersect supp(eta') extend through the normal PML region |n| > L_2, where alpha_2 != 1 and L_sigma != L_{sigma,t}; there the terms eta(L_sigma - L_{sigma,t})U^pm_{sigma,t} and the change of the s-derivative coefficient from alpha_1^{-1} to alpha_2/alpha_1 contribute additional sources omitted in eq:QBim-W-PDE. Since the flat model has no normal absorption, its fields are not small at these depths, so the omitted terms are not a priori negligible and the derivation of eq:QBim-correction-by-U is incomplete.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Include the coefficient-mismatch terms in F^pm_{sigma,b} (or localize eta U_{sigma,t} to |n| < L_2 with a two-dimensional cutoff) and estimate their contribution to the trace chi_im gamma_+ W^+ using the exponential damping of propagation from the normal-PML parts of the strips back to Gamma_im; the lemma's bound is then recovered by a contained argument.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of lem:QBim-correction-separated is incomplete as written, and with it the proofs of lem:QBim-family, cor:Ainv-Bim-small, and thm:computable-convergence; the correction estimate eq:QBim-correction-by-U is unproven.
issues.title: Commutator identity for the flat-pair correction is applied outside the region where the flat operator equals the true PML operator
issues.why_classification: The repair requires a new contained estimate (damped back-propagation of the deep-strip sources) but no restructuring of the overall argument and no loss in the final results.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: In the subsequent analysis, \(L_1,L_2,d_1\) are fixed, while \(\bar\sigma\to\infty\) and \(d_2=d_2(\bar\sigma)\to\infty\) in error estimates.

issues.failure_explanation: lem:QBim-separated-fields asserts an exponentially small H^1 bound for the flat pair over the full-depth strips C_b^pm. The flat operator L_{sigma,t} stretches only the tangential coordinate, so its modes cos(xi s) e^{lambda n} have Re lambda(xi) ~ sigma xi^2/(k(1+sigma^2)^2) -> 0 as sigma-bar -> infinity for each fixed xi (with lambda(0) = -ik): normally propagating radiation launched by the boundary data on supp chi_im crosses the strips essentially undamped down to depth L_2+d_2. The s-separation from supp chi_im gives exponential damping only for depths |n| less than about sigma d_b; beyond it the imaginary part of the stretched distance degrades like sigma d_s^2/|n|, so the uniform pointwise bound |D^-_{sigma,alpha}(x,s_0)| <= C P(sigma-bar) e^{-c_b sigma-bar} for all x in C_b^- invoked in the proof fails at large depth, and the true size of the flat pair on the strips is only algebraically small (about sigma-bar^{-1/2}). The stated estimate therefore fails for large sigma-bar, and with it the exponential bound eq:QBim-return-small used in the proof of lem:QBim-family.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace eq:QBim-separated-U-small by an algebraic bound (splitting the strips at depth of order sigma d_b: exponential smallness near the boundary, oscillatory estimates beyond), combine with the repaired W-equation, and re-derive eq:QBim-return-small via the exponentially damped back-propagation from the deep strips to Gamma_im (or weaken the intermediate rates and check that the algebraic contributions still yield at most C sigma_0^{-1/2} in eq:QBim-final-sup).
issues.overall_effect: lem:QBim-separated-fields' estimate is false as stated; eq:QBim-return-small and the proofs of lem:QBim-family, cor:Ainv-Bim-small, and thm:computable-convergence are unproven as written (the final statements appear recoverable by a different argument).
issues.title: Claimed exponential smallness of the flat half-plane pair on the full-depth separation strips is false (the model has no normal absorption)
issues.why_classification: The stated lemma is false and must be replaced by a different estimate requiring new contained analysis; the downstream results keep their statements under the repaired argument, so there is no major loss, but the repair is more than a local routine fix.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: In the PML region define the formal complex-scaled extension $u_\sigma^\infty(x):=u(F_\sigma(x))$, by the outgoing analytic continuation.

Let \(\mathcal S_\sigma^\infty\) and \(\mathcal K_\sigma^\infty\) be the single- and double-layer boundary integral operators defined the same as ${\cal S}_\sigma^c$ and ${\cal K}_\sigma^c$ but with $\Gamma_R$ replaced by the whole impedance boundary \(\Sigma\).

issues.failure_explanation: Section 6 claims that phi^infty = u^infty|_Sigma, with u^infty = u after F_sigma, solves A^infty phi = S^infty g, whose operators are defined the same as S^c and K^c (kernel Phi_k(F_sigma x, F_sigma y), conormal nu . A_sigma grad_y). On the flat PML part of Sigma the chain rule gives the conormal of u^infty as -alpha_1 (partial_2 u) after F_sigma, while the analytically continued impedance condition gives -(partial_2 u) after F_sigma - Z u after F_sigma = 0 there; hence (conormal + M_beta) u^infty = (alpha_1 - 1) Z u^infty != 0 on the PML part (on the physical part, alpha_1 = 1, the condition holds exactly). The Green representation for u^infty therefore yields (1/2 I + K^infty + S^infty M_beta) phi^infty = S^infty g + S^infty[(alpha_1-1) Z 1_PML phi^infty], not eq:complex-scaled-bie: the scaled trace solves the complex-scaled BIE only up to a nonzero Robin-defect term (exponentially small, since the continued trace decays in the PML, but not zero).
